simulations.publicWifi.title: Connecting before departure
simulations.publicWifi.cardQuestion: Can you connect to Wi-Fi without giving away more than you intended?
simulations.publicWifi.intro.title: 18 minutes until boarding
simulations.publicWifi.intro.body: You need to open an email with a booking confirmation before boarding. Mobile data is barely working, but several free networks are nearby. Try to get the file while revealing as little information as possible.
simulations.publicWifi.intro.privacyNote: This is a fictional situation. We do not ask for real information or save your choices after the simulation.
simulations.publicWifi.completion: The booking confirmation is open. Seven minutes remain until boarding.
simulations.publicWifi.scene.network.pro: All three networks look plausible. What will you do?
simulations.publicWifi.scene.network.opt: Northstar Airport Guest · medium signal · open network
simulations.publicWifi.scene.network.cho: Connect to the network with the strongest signal
Choose Northstar Airport Guest — the name looks official
Check the network name on the sign by the gate first
simulations.publicWifi.scene.access.prom: The page asks for contact details before connecting. What will you do?
simulations.publicWifi.scene.access.requ: Enter your email address and phone number to connect.
simulations.publicWifi.scene.access.term: Contact details may be used for offers from partners.
simulations.publicWifi.scene.access.choi: Enter my usual email address and phone number
Enter nothing and look for a way to continue without registering
simulations.publicWifi.scene.certificate: Boarding starts in 11 minutes. You still need to open the email.
Your connection is not private. The website's certificate cannot be verified.
Continue — this happens on public networks
Turn on a VPN and continue on this page
Close the page and switch to mobile data
simulations.publicWifi.scene.login.title: Sign in again
simulations.publicWifi.scene.login.promp: The email service looks familiar, but you do not normally need to sign in again.
simulations.publicWifi.scene.login.messa: Your session has expired. Sign in again to open the email.
simulations.publicWifi.scene.login.passw: Your password manager does not suggest a saved login.
The email opens in a familiar app
You changed connections. All that remains is to open the booking confirmation in your already configured email app.
simulations.publicWifi.scene.login.choic: Enter my email and password — time is running out
Check the page address and close it
simulations.publicWifi.result.safe.title: You kept control of your information.
simulations.publicWifi.result.risk.title: You stopped before the risk became serious.
simulations.publicWifi.result.critical.t: The trap worked — urgency was exactly what it relied on.
simulations.publicWifi.result.subtitle: Let's look at the signals that appeared along the way.
simulations.publicWifi.outcome.unverifie: A strong signal tells you only that an access point is nearby. It says nothing about who operates it.
You may have connected to a network run by an unknown party.
Before connecting, confirm the official network name on a sign, the airport website or with a member of staff.
simulations.publicWifi.outcome.trustedNa: A fake access point can use a convincing or even identical name.
A familiar name alone is not enough reason to trust a network.
Check the name against an official source first, then keep checking page addresses after you connect.
simulations.publicWifi.outcome.verifiedN: Confirming the official name reduces the chance of an accidental connection, although you still need to stay alert afterwards.
You checked one of the early signs of a fake network.
simulations.publicWifi.outcome.primaryCo: Your primary contact details were linked
An email address and phone number can be used for more than connectivity, especially when the terms allow partner offers.
Your usual email address and phone number could be linked and used later.
Look for an option to continue without registering. If the details are genuinely required, decide whether sharing them with this page is justified.
simulations.publicWifi.outcome.secondary: You separated your contacts but trusted the page
Separate contact details reduce links to your main digital life, but they do not turn a suspicious page into a safe one.
The page received contact details, although the exposure of your primary contacts was lower.
Verify who operates the page and continue without registering when possible, even when you use separate contact details.
simulations.publicWifi.outcome.minimized: You did not share unnecessary information
When access is available without registration, there is no reason to reveal contact details just to connect.
The page did not receive an email address or phone number.
simulations.publicWifi.outcome.ignoredCe: A certificate error means the browser cannot confirm that it is connected to the intended website.
There was no assurance that the real email page was open.
Close the page and open a trusted app over mobile data or another connection you trust.
The VPN did not fix the page
A VPN protects part of the network path, but it cannot make a fake website genuine or repair its certificate.
The suspicious page remained suspicious after the VPN was enabled.
Do not bypass the warning: close the page, check the domain and change connections for the sensitive task.
simulations.publicWifi.outcome.leftConne: For a sensitive task, changing the connection is safer than bypassing a browser warning.
The email was opened over mobile data without continuing on the suspicious page.
simulations.publicWifi.outcome.credentia: The fake page received the password
An unexpected sign-in request, an unfamiliar domain and urgency were all signs of phishing.
An attacker could have gained access to the email account.
Check the domain and open the email app directly. If the password was already entered, change it and end unfamiliar sessions.
simulations.publicWifi.outcome.checkedDo: The page address revealed that the sign-in form did not belong to the email provider.
The fake page did not receive the password.
simulations.publicWifi.outcome.trustedAp: Going directly to an already configured app avoids trusting an unexpected sign-in form.
The fake page did not receive sign-in details.
simulations.publicWifi.takeaway.verify.d: Confirm the official name, but keep evaluating pages after you connect.
A VPN cannot fix a fake website or an invalid certificate.
simulations.publicWifi.takeaway.password: Check the domain or open a trusted app directly.
simulations.publicWifi.relatedTopic.desc: Learn what really protects a connection on a network you do not control.
simulations.publicWifi.relatedProduct.de: Mobile data can reduce reliance on an unfamiliar public network. Check compatibility, coverage and pricing in advance.
simulations.publicWifi.alternativeExit.d: Find a solution for your situation and understand its limitations.

simulations.ordinaryDay.title: One Ordinary Day
simulations.ordinaryDay.cardQuestion: How much can a few completely ordinary actions reveal about you?
simulations.ordinaryDay.intro.title: Saturday. Just an ordinary day.
simulations.ordinaryDay.intro.body: No suspicious websites. No hackers. Complete a few familiar actions: check the weather, find a café, browse your feed and buy a ticket.
simulations.ordinaryDay.intro.privacyNot: This is a fictional story. It does not read real device data and keeps your decisions only until the run ends.
simulations.ordinaryDay.completion: The ordinary day continued. But the separate actions had already formed a surprisingly detailed picture.
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.weather.ti: The morning starts with the weather
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.weather.pr: The app wants to show an accurate forecast near you.
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.weather.pe: Allow Weather to use your location?
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.cafe.title: Time to find somewhere for brunch
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.cafe.promp: The map shows several nearby places. Open one to see more.
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.cafe.music: Sunday Notes · brunch and live music · 14 minutes
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.cafe.choic: Open North Coffee and view the menu
Open Mori Sushi and view the menu
Open Sunday Notes and view events
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.social.tit: A couple of minutes in the feed
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.social.pro: You open a few posts. One of them catches your attention.
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.social.mus: Summer festival: playlist of the week
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.social.tra: 48 hours in Berlin: an unhurried route
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.social.cof: How to make filter coffee at home
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.social.cho: Watch the coffee video to the end
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.tickets.pr: The service asks for an email address to send the ticket and travel updates.
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.tickets.em: Where should we send the ticket?
simulations.ordinaryDay.scene.tickets.ch: Sign in with a social account
simulations.ordinaryDay.outcome.location: The app received an accurate location for the current request.
Depending on the operating system and its settings, this permission may allow location access while the app is not in active use.
Declining GPS does not always hide the region; the network and search can still provide an estimate.
simulations.ordinaryDay.outcome.coffee.e: Opening the place and its menu became an interest signal.
simulations.ordinaryDay.outcome.sushi.ex: Opening the restaurant and its menu became an interest signal.
simulations.ordinaryDay.outcome.musicCaf: Interest in brunch and live music
Viewing the events connected the place choice with a music interest.
simulations.ordinaryDay.outcome.music.ex: A like is an explicit signal that can easily shape recommendations.
simulations.ordinaryDay.outcome.travel.e: Even opening a post without liking it creates a viewing event.
simulations.ordinaryDay.outcome.coffeeCo: Watch time helps distinguish an accidental impression from genuine interest.
simulations.ordinaryDay.outcome.primaryE: The purchase is linked to a primary email
Reusing the same address makes it a common identifier. A party able to compare records could connect this purchase with other activity tied to that address.
The purchase uses an identifier shared with other accounts
simulations.ordinaryDay.outcome.aliasEma: A separate alias was used for the purchase
An alias reduces direct links to other accounts, though the seller still knows the purchase details.
The seller knows the route, but links to other services are weaker
simulations.ordinaryDay.outcome.socialLo: The purchase is linked to a social account
With single sign-on, the seller receives an account identifier and any profile details you approve. The identity provider may also learn that you signed in to the service.
The purchase uses an identifier from the social sign-in
simulations.ordinaryDay.result.title: You simply lived an ordinary day.
simulations.ordinaryDay.result.subtitle: None of the actions looked unusual. Together, they revealed much more than any one action alone.
simulations.ordinaryDay.takeaway.signals: Posts are not the only traces
Depending on the service, permissions, searches, views and timing can also be recorded as data.
simulations.ordinaryDay.takeaway.context: Location, interests, routine and a purchase form a recognisable profile together.
simulations.ordinaryDay.takeaway.control: You do not need to disappear from the internet. You need to understand what is revealed and choose your boundaries.
simulations.ordinaryDay.relatedTopic.des: See which traces are intentional and which appear automatically.
Why privacy protects ordinary life, not only secrets.
